messages.content:
Users of the notes editor are losing what they typed last. If you keep typing while the
autosave is waiting, the draft that gets saved has the text of your first keystroke
instead of your last one, and in the title (which is saved at the first keystroke)
nothing typed after that first keystroke is saved at all. Closing the note right after
typing saves the old text too. It looks like debounce in src/debounce.ts loses the
calls made while it is waiting: the call that runs at the end of the wait, at maxWait,
or on flush() should be the last one, also with leading on, and pending() should say
so while one is waiting. You can see it with
`node --experimental-strip-types bin/autosave-sim.ts --wait 800 examples/typing.txt`.

While you are in there: the UX team finished their typing-pause study, and the delays
they want for each field (a wait and a maxWait) are in config/autosave-delays.json.
Please make the autosave use the delays from that file for each field instead of the
fixed 1000 ms. Delays passed to createAutosave, and --wait and --max-wait in
autosave-sim, should still override them.

Calls that are further apart than the wait, throttle, and the simulator's output
format should keep working as they do now.
